summary: Firestore with deny-by-default rules and helpers for roles and server-clock audit stamps, emulator-tested; a cursor-paged table source; typed document reading that names a malformed record; exact money storage.

packageName.label: Dart package name
packageName.help: Lower case with underscores, e.g. acme_crm. It is the app's import name and cannot contain spaces.

firebaseProjectId.label: Firebase project ID
firebaseProjectId.help: The Google Cloud / Firebase project this application uses, e.g. acme-crm-prod. It must already exist with Firebase enabled.
